skill.sparkwitch.ceremonial_sword.name: Ceremonial Sword
skill.sparkwitch.ceremonial_sword.descri: Complete 2 tasks to permanently receive a free Ceremonial Sword this round. Either hand: +40% movement speed (does not stack). Sword attack speed: 2. Successful kills share a 30s cooldown; right-click dash has an independent 5s cooldown and still moves you during kill cooldown. Pierces shields, but consumes protections and triggers retaliation. Trait-based protections, including Last Stand and Last Escape, are not bypassed.

guidebook.sparkassist.noellesroles.recal: Marks a recall point and spends money to return, backed by passive income and mobility shop tools.
guidebook.sparkassist.noellesroles.coron: Examines bodies, earns money near corpses, and uses body bags to unlock corpse-identity disguises.
guidebook.sparkassist.noellesroles.phant: Uses the backpack to select another living player and make them invisible for 30 seconds; the backpack ability has an independent 90-second cooldown.
guidebook.sparkassist.noellesroles.silen: Silences the specified Wathe knife, revolver, and bat sounds, including when a Coroner uses a Silencer disguise.

guidebook.sparkassist.faction.pending: 这个阵营页面已经准备好接入完整的玩家手册正文。
Wraith is not assigned at round start. A player from the Civilian, Killer, or Witch faction may become a Wraith after death.
Escaping, voluntarily leaving the train, and end-of-round digestion do not trigger conversion.
Conversion preserves existing traits and adds Cautious, but clears inventory, money, and mana.
A base Wraith is invisible, collisionless, and invulnerable, with Slowness II and Blindness. Promotion removes Slowness and Blindness.
Base Wraiths and all promotions except Guardian Angel cannot send text chat.
Base and promoted Wraiths obey the map no-jump rule and create no walking, landing, or sprinting particles.
Wraiths cannot pick up ground items and are unaffected by other players or Wind Spirit charges.
Base Wraiths and Vendettas see nameless Steve models for players and bodies. Other promotions see real appearances.
Wraith restores the previous tasks and keeps at least 3 distinct tasks. The third task completed after conversion triggers promotion.
Civilian-faction Wraiths promote to Wind Spirit, Guardian Angel, or an eligible Vendetta. Killer-faction Wraiths promote to Saboteur. Witch-faction Wraiths promote to Curser.
Promotion restores ordinary right-click interactions and clearer vision. Shared no-jump, particle, and pickup restrictions remain.
guidebook.sparkassist.sparkwitch.wind_sp: Wind Spirit belongs to the Civilian faction and is one of its three Wraith promotions.
Permanently has Speed II. A higher Speed effect is preserved, and Speed II returns when it ends.
The shop sells one vanilla Wind Charge for 50 money with unlimited purchases and no shop cooldown.
Wind Spirit charges knock back ordinary living players, but never Wraiths or promoted roles, and deal no extra damage.
Has Killer Instinct and follows its usual hiding rules.
Immune to blackout Blindness, gains Night Vision during blackout, and has unlimited stamina.
Each task completed after promotion grants 50 money.
Wind Spirit sees real player and body appearances. Wraith chat, jump, footstep-particle, and pickup restrictions remain.
guidebook.sparkassist.sparkwitch.guardia: Guardian Angel belongs to the Civilian faction and is one of its three Wraith promotions.
Has unlimited stamina, is immune to blackouts, and can identify poisoned food, drinks, and beds.

After a 60-second promotion delay, aim at a living player within 3 blocks and press the role ability key to apply a hidden protective shield for 10 seconds. A successful use has a 90-second cooldown. The protected target is outlined through walls in the Guardian Angel role color and is visible only to the Guardian Angel.
Guardian Angel can use text chat and speak with dead players in the dead voice channel.
Guardian Angel sees real player and body appearances. Wraith jump, footstep-particle, and pickup restrictions remain.
guidebook.sparkassist.sparkwitch.vendett: Vendetta belongs to the Civilian faction. It enters the promotion pool only when the killer bound at the first death remains eligible.
Vendetta sees other players and bodies as nameless Steve models.
The world fades toward grayscale with distance, while the bound target always has a red outline.
The bound killer has a persistent red through-wall outline within 4 blocks and is also outlined for 5 seconds after each new 30-second countdown ends.

Only Vendetta and the killer responsible for the first death can affect one another. The Vendetta Knife can succeed once: hold use for at least 0.5 seconds, then release to stab the bound killer within 3 blocks and line of sight.
The Revenge Knife uses the ordinary knife appearance and supports external skins.
Vendetta remains unable to chat, use living voice, jump, create footstep particles, or pick up items.
guidebook.sparkassist.sparkwitch.saboteu: Saboteur is the Killer-faction Wraith promotion and wins with the Killer faction.
The shop contains a Lockpick for 50 money and the usual Blackout purchase.
Promotion starts a 60-second cooldown. When ready, Sabotage disables powered lights within 20 blocks, then starts a 120-second cooldown.
Using Sabotage with no eligible lights nearby still consumes the full cooldown.
Sabotage and Blackout are independent. When they overlap, lights return only after both effects end.
Sabotage does not affect torches, redstone lamps, held dynamic lights, or lights from other mods.
Each task completed after promotion grants 50 money; the task that triggered promotion is not rewarded retroactively.
Saboteur sees real player and body appearances. Wraith chat, voice, jump, footstep-particle, and pickup restrictions remain.
Curser is the Witch-faction Wraith promotion. Curser wins with the Witch faction when every living player belongs to it.
Curser sees real player and body appearances. Wraith chat, voice, jump, footstep-particle, and pickup restrictions remain.
skill.sparkwitch.ceremonial_sword.protec: Pierces shields and parries, but still consumes protections and triggers retaliation. A protected Witch Maiden can die with the Grand Witch. The crosshair bar shows attack recharge, not dash or kill cooldown; gray means killing is unavailable. Trait-based protections, including Last Stand and Last Escape, are not bypassed.
skill.sparkwitch.witch_factor.name: Witch Factor
skill.sparkwitch.witch_factor.descriptio: Primary ability (default G): freely spread a factor to the living player under your crosshair within 8 unobstructed blocks. Success starts a 20-second cooldown. Capacity is floor(round participants / 5); one factor per player.
skill.sparkwitch.witch_factor.income: Each factor grants 25 mana every 30 seconds, or 40 from an Apprentice Witch and 60 from a Murderous Witch.
skill.sparkwitch.witch_factor.sanity: Every 60 seconds, holders with sanity lose 10 sanity; an Apprentice Witch loses 30. Factor holders appear red in Grand Witch and Accomplice instinct, without bypassing instinct hiding.
skill.sparkwitch.witch_factor.transfer: On a player kill, the factor transfers to the killer and retains its timer. Grand Witch/Accomplice kills, environmental deaths, invalid or already marked killers, and recruiting the holder reclaim it without bonus mana.
skill.sparkwitch.recruit_accomplice.name: Recruit Accomplice
skill.sparkwitch.recruit_accomplice.desc: After 2 tasks, use ability key 2 (default N) on a living player within 8 unobstructed blocks to force them into Accomplice. Free, no cooldown. Cannot recruit yourself or an existing Accomplice. Quota: max(0, floor((round participants - 18) / 6)); successful recruits consume it permanently, even if they die. Accomplices are no longer assigned naturally.
skill.sparkwitch.recruit_accomplice.inve: Only keys, master keys, revolvers and letters remain. Other items, including food and drinks, convert to coins at shop value, or 25 each if unpriced. Existing coins are preserved; the new role's shop purchase limits reset.
